intro: La Liga’s 111th Seville derby will be a top-half affair as Sevilla look to correct a slight wobble and narrow the eight-point gap to high-flying rivals Real Betis.
h2h: Betis could post a second straight away H2H win for the first time since 2011/12 after losing eight of the 11 prior (W1, D2). It has been a tightly-contested match-up with only one of the last ten competitive derbies being decided by a 2+ goal margin.
datos: Two thirds of the goals in Sevilla’s league games this term arrived in the second half.
Sevilla led at half-time in only one La Liga home match this season (HT: D3, L2).
Nine of Betis’s 11 first-half goals in La Liga this campaign arrived after the 30th minute.
Six of Betis’ eight La Liga wins this season came by a one-goal margin.
Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Isaac Romero is Sevilla’s leading scorer this season and will be out to score in a second consecutive Seville derby - his last three home goals for the club arrived in the first half. Betis’ Rodrigo Riquelme netted in each of his last two competitive appearances, with 11 of his 12 goals for Betis coming on the road.
Sevilla pair Marcão and Peque Fernández face a race against time to be fit here, as do Betis’ Cucho Hernández and Diego Llorente.
For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.
The H2H history and the visitors’ narrow wins this season suggest a punt on Betis to win by a one-goal margin would be smart.
